title: Auth outcome event v1
description: Auth outcome event published best-effort per decision (ADR 0008). Secret-free. See docs/design/09-schemas-and-versioning.md #1.

schemaVersion.description: Schema major version. Consumers reject unknown majors.

outcome.description: Whether the decision was a grant or a denial.

reason.description: Stable reason code. New codes are additive (no schemaVersion bump); consumers treat unknown codes as generic failure.

application.description: Absent when no application was selected.

principal.description: sub/azp-style identifier, never the raw token.
